summary: No role cleared every hard gate on November 7. Mistral AI posted two Paris Forward Software Engineer roles on November 6: one builds production AI agents with a strong security focus, the other the data pipelines and evaluation loops beneath them. Neither publishes pay or an office-day rule. Two recruiter listings for unnamed Paris clients state terms that would pass (€90K fixed plus equity with 2–3 office days, and €80K–€120K+ plus equity with four office days), but the employers could not be identified or checked. EverAI’s new France-specific remote LLM engineer requisition was rejected: its €75K–€125K range includes bonus and starts below the floor. These entries are research leads, not recommendations.
coverage: Automated official-ATS sweep on November 7: 130 of 276 attempted Ashby, Lever and Greenhouse board aliases returned data; many failed aliases are likely wrong board names, not evidence of no vacancies. The sweep screened AI-titled roles on reachable boards, Paris- or France-located engineering roles with published pay on reachable Ashby boards, Greenhouse and Lever data for 108 France-located engineering roles (32 with pay text), and Ashby engineering roles first published since November 6 with a France or Europe-remote location. Compared with November 6’s sweep, it surfaced a small number of new requisitions. A second pass reached 41 of 300 attempted aliases, a Workable and Recruitee check reached 6 of 44, and a pass over additional company names reached 49 of 315 attempted aliases. Four web searches were used for discovery only; they added the two recruiter listings. Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; an AI employer, coding assistant use or AI product UI alone does not establish the required assignment.

Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Use the lower bound; equity is not cash; packages, OTE, unlabelled pay ranges and estimates do not pass.
No unchanged prior selections. Requisition identity takes precedence over refreshed titles, URLs or timestamps; historical qualification is not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Sources checked November 7, 2026. Unpublished pay is recorded as unknown, not as below the threshold; Mistral AI publishes no salary for either new role.

The two recruiter listings are recorded as near-misses because the hiring companies are not named. Their pay and attendance terms are recruiter statements; employer pages, posting dates and company finances could not be checked. Salary figures seen only on job aggregators (for example consulting-firm listings whose own text says pay depends on profile) were not counted.

Other new postings screened and not listed: Cohere’s Software Engineer, ML Ops (remote, “Europe” with no named countries, no pay, and a developer-platform and CI remit for researchers); Pennylane’s Senior Application Security Engineer (remote in France, not AI-centred); and several Mistral AI engineering-manager roles that are primarily people management.

Believe’s Staff Engineer Agentic AI (near-miss November 6) is still listed with no compensation data. Sierra’s Software Engineer, Agent (near-miss October 18) reappeared in the sweep with the same requisition and terms. Neither is re-listed.
Deduplication covered the accessible October 10 to November 6 reports and the supplied October 3/5 Escape history.
Company financial diligence was not advanced because no role was ranked; the product notes are employer- or recruiter-stated only.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. Zero new roles qualified today. Mistral AI’s two roles would need a published base salary above €100,000 (or at least €80,000 with explicit equity) and an explicit Paris attendance rule; the recruiter leads would need the employer to be identified and its terms confirmed. No applications or outreach were made.

This role sits in Applied AI, works with customer-facing teams and turns what works for one customer into reusable patterns; the listing says security is “a big part of where we're heading” and names alert triage, threat hunting and investigation agents as relevant experience. Specific customer projects are not named.[1][3]

jobs.title: Mid/Senior AI LLM Engineer (Full Remote - France)
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing: location “France; Portugal”, location type Remote, “Work From Anywhere: Fully remote.” The company says it prefers B2B contracts but is flexible.[7][8]

salary.quote: “Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €75K – €125K.” The listing says “Published ranges reflect total gross annual compensation, including any applicable target bonus.” No equity is stated.[7]
